name: mask-config-secrets
title: Mask sensitive system_config values in admin API
description: GET /admin/config returns every system_config row verbatim, including MASTER_KEY, WEB_SEARCH_API_KEY, WEB_FETCH_API_KEY and alert webhook URLs. Mask them in the list response and switch the two config UIs to write-only editing (set a new value, never read the old one back).
creator: chiwalau
